By leveraging these classes, you can easily build complex responsive user interfaces."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Enabling Flexbox"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"To apply flexbox properties, you first need to turn an element into a flex container using the display utilities.
